g.text: GAIT OBSERVATIONS FOR MEDICAL WORLD MODELS

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #bb6234
font-weight: 700; font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #153448

g.text: Motion-aware masking must retain quiet movement.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a79

g.text: A complementary design tests high-motion and low-motion regions under the same target budget.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a79

g.text: Slow or constrained motion may be informative. Mask selection must not depend on the future or a diagnosis label.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a79

g.text: Sources: MAMP; ASMa, TMLR 2026. Prefix-only reliability gating is a proposed adaptation.
